outcome_summary: Legal and regulatory requirements involving AI are understood, managed and documented.
rationale: SOC 2 objective-setting considers applicable laws, but the scope is security and privacy, not AI-specific regulation.
ai_control_to_add: Keep an AI regulatory register (EU AI Act, Colorado AI Act, sector rules) with an owner and applicability for each AI system.

outcome_summary: Trustworthy AI characteristics are built into policies, processes and procedures.
rationale: Codes of conduct and policies exist, but they don't define trustworthy-AI principles.
ai_control_to_add: Adopt AI principles (validity, safety, fairness, transparency, privacy) and embed them in an AI policy.

outcome_summary: The depth of AI risk management is set by the organization's risk tolerance.
rationale: A risk assessment process exists but has no AI risk tiers.
ai_control_to_add: Define AI risk tiers that set the required review depth for each system.

outcome_summary: The risk management process is set through transparent policies, procedures and controls.
rationale: SOC 2 policy deployment and control selection map directly.
ai_control_to_add: Add an AI governance policy under the same approval and publication cycle.

outcome_summary: The risk management process is monitored and periodically reviewed, with defined roles and review frequency.
rationale: Monitoring activities and defined responsibilities map directly.
ai_control_to_add: Add the AI risk program to the annual control review calendar.

outcome_summary: Mechanisms are in place to inventory AI systems.
rationale: SOC 2 asset inventories cover infrastructure and software, not AI use cases or models.
ai_control_to_add: Maintain an AI system inventory: owner, purpose, data used, model or vendor, risk tier.

outcome_summary: AI systems are decommissioned safely without increasing risk.
rationale: Asset and data disposal are covered; retiring a model and its dependencies is not.
ai_control_to_add: Write a decommissioning procedure covering dependencies, model and data artifacts, and user notice.

outcome_summary: Roles, responsibilities and communication lines for AI risk are documented and clear.
rationale: Organizational structure and internal communication map directly.
ai_control_to_add: Add AI roles (system owner, risk reviewer, approver) to the RACI chart.

outcome_summary: Personnel and partners receive AI risk management training.
rationale: Security awareness training exists but doesn't cover AI risk.
ai_control_to_add: Add role-based AI risk and AI literacy training (also supports EU AI Act Article 4).

outcome_summary: Executive leadership takes responsibility for AI risk decisions.
rationale: Board and management oversight and accountability map directly.
ai_control_to_add: Name an accountable executive and put AI risk on the oversight committee agenda.

outcome_summary: AI risk decisions are informed by a diverse, interdisciplinary team.
rationale: SOC 2 addresses competence, not diversity of perspectives.
ai_control_to_add: Require cross-functional review (legal, domain experts, user perspective) for high-risk AI.

outcome_summary: Roles for human-AI configurations and human oversight are defined.
rationale: No SOC 2 equivalent for human oversight of automated decisions.
ai_control_to_add: Define human-in-the-loop or human-on-the-loop requirements for each risk tier.

outcome_summary: Policies foster critical thinking and a safety-first mindset in AI design and use.
rationale: Tone at the top and ethical values apply, but not AI safety specifically.
ai_control_to_add: Require pre-deployment risk sign-off and add AI expectations to the code of conduct.

outcome_summary: Teams document AI risks and potential impacts and communicate them.
rationale: SOC 2 risk assessment covers risks to service objectives, not impacts on individuals.
ai_control_to_add: Complete an AI impact assessment for each in-scope system.

outcome_summary: Practices enable AI testing, incident identification and information sharing.
rationale: Security event detection exists; AI failures such as drift or harmful output are out of scope.
ai_control_to_add: Expand incident definitions to include AI incidents and set testing requirements.

outcome_summary: Feedback from people outside the AI team about impacts is collected and integrated.
rationale: External communication and privacy complaint channels exist.
ai_control_to_add: Create a feedback channel for people affected by AI and route it to the system owner.

outcome_summary: Adjudicated feedback is regularly incorporated into system design.
rationale: Deficiency remediation and change management provide the mechanism.
ai_control_to_add: Route accepted AI feedback into the model change backlog.

outcome_summary: Policies address third-party AI risks, including intellectual property infringement.
rationale: Vendor risk management covers security, not training-data rights or model IP.
ai_control_to_add: Use an AI vendor due-diligence questionnaire covering data use, IP indemnity and model changes.

outcome_summary: Contingency processes handle failures in high-risk third-party data or AI systems.
rationale: Business continuity and vendor contingency exist but don't address model outages or deprecation.
ai_control_to_add: Add fallback plans for critical AI vendors.

outcome_summary: Intended purposes, context, laws and deployment settings are understood and documented.
rationale: The system description and objectives cover the service, not each AI use.
ai_control_to_add: Write an intended-use statement and deployment context for each AI system.

outcome_summary: Interdisciplinary actors take part in establishing context, and their participation is documented.
rationale: No SOC 2 equivalent.
ai_control_to_add: Record who participated in context-setting for each high-risk system.

outcome_summary: The organization's mission and goals for AI are understood and documented.
rationale: Objectives are specified, but not for AI.
ai_control_to_add: Write an AI strategy statement tied to business objectives.

outcome_summary: The business value of the AI system is defined, or re-evaluated for existing systems.
rationale: Objective-setting applies; no requirement to justify AI use.
ai_control_to_add: Require a business case at AI intake and re-review it for existing systems.

outcome_summary: Organizational risk tolerances are determined and documented.
rationale: Risk appetite is often implicit in SOC 2 risk assessments.
ai_control_to_add: Get leadership approval for a documented AI risk tolerance statement.

outcome_summary: System requirements are gathered, and design accounts for socio-technical risks.
rationale: SDLC and change controls gather technical requirements only.
ai_control_to_add: Add privacy, fairness and transparency requirements to AI design reviews.

outcome_summary: The AI system's tasks and methods are defined.
rationale: No SOC 2 equivalent.
ai_control_to_add: Keep a model card stating task type, method and model.

outcome_summary: Knowledge limits and how humans use and oversee outputs are documented.
rationale: The system description doesn't cover model limitations.
ai_control_to_add: Document known limitations and guidance for users.

outcome_summary: Scientific integrity and testing considerations, including data representativeness, are documented.
rationale: Processing integrity addresses data completeness and accuracy, not representativeness.
ai_control_to_add: Add a data suitability and representativeness review.

outcome_summary: Potential benefits of the AI system are examined and documented.
rationale: No SOC 2 equivalent.
ai_control_to_add: Record expected benefits in the AI impact assessment.

outcome_summary: Potential costs of AI errors, including non-monetary costs, are examined against risk tolerance.
rationale: Risk analysis rates impact on objectives, not costs to people.
ai_control_to_add: Add an error-impact analysis tied to the AI risk tolerance.

outcome_summary: The targeted application scope is specified and documented.
rationale: No SOC 2 equivalent.
ai_control_to_add: Document approved scope and prohibited uses for each system.

outcome_summary: Operator and practitioner proficiency processes are defined and assessed.
rationale: Commitment to competence applies.
ai_control_to_add: Add operator training and competency checks for AI systems.

outcome_summary: Human oversight processes are defined, assessed and documented.
rationale: No SOC 2 equivalent for oversight of AI outputs.
ai_control_to_add: Define and periodically test human oversight procedures.

outcome_summary: Legal and technology risks of AI components, including third-party data, software and IP, are mapped.
rationale: Vendor and risk assessment apply but don't cover licensing or training-data provenance.
ai_control_to_add: Keep an AI bill of materials with license and data-rights review.

outcome_summary: Internal risk controls for AI components, including third-party AI, are identified and documented.
rationale: Control selection and technology general controls map directly.
ai_control_to_add: Extend the control matrix to cover AI components.

outcome_summary: Likelihood and magnitude of each identified impact are documented.
rationale: SOC 2 risk analysis rates likelihood and impact, but only against service objectives.
ai_control_to_add: Extend risk scoring to impacts on individuals and society.

outcome_summary: Practices for engaging AI actors and integrating feedback about impacts are in place.
rationale: External communication channels exist.
ai_control_to_add: Write a stakeholder engagement plan for high-risk systems.

outcome_summary: Metrics for the most significant AI risks are selected; unmeasurable risks are documented.
rationale: Monitoring activities exist but have no AI metrics.
ai_control_to_add: Create an AI metrics plan, including a list of risks that can't be measured.

outcome_summary: Metric appropriateness and control effectiveness are regularly assessed.
rationale: Control monitoring and deficiency evaluation map directly.
ai_control_to_add: Include AI metrics in periodic control testing.

outcome_summary: Internal experts or independent assessors are involved in regular assessments.
rationale: Separate evaluations (for example internal audit) map directly.
ai_control_to_add: Schedule independent reviews of high-risk AI (aligns with ISO/IEC 42001 clause 9.2).

outcome_summary: Test sets, metrics and test tools are documented.
rationale: Change testing is documented, but not model evaluation.
ai_control_to_add: Keep testing documentation for each model release.

outcome_summary: Evaluations involving people meet human-subject protection requirements.
rationale: Only consent concepts overlap.
ai_control_to_add: Add a human-subject protection review for user studies and evaluations.

outcome_summary: Performance is measured in conditions similar to deployment.
rationale: Processing accuracy applies to deterministic systems.
ai_control_to_add: Set pre-deployment performance acceptance criteria.

outcome_summary: AI system behavior is monitored in production.
rationale: Anomaly and capacity monitoring don't detect model drift.
ai_control_to_add: Add drift and output-quality monitoring.

outcome_summary: The AI system is shown to be valid and reliable; generalization limits are documented.
rationale: Processing integrity is the closest analog.
ai_control_to_add: Produce a validation report for each release.

outcome_summary: The AI system is evaluated for safety and can fail safely.
rationale: Recovery and incident response apply after failure, not safe-failure design.
ai_control_to_add: Add safety testing and fail-safe design requirements.

outcome_summary: AI system security and resilience are evaluated and documented.
rationale: Core SOC 2 territory.
ai_control_to_add: Add AI-specific threats: prompt injection, data poisoning, model theft.

outcome_summary: Transparency and accountability risks are examined and documented.
rationale: Notice and external communication apply.
ai_control_to_add: Disclose AI use and its limits to users.

outcome_summary: The model is explained and validated, and outputs are interpreted in context.
rationale: No SOC 2 equivalent.
ai_control_to_add: Document explainability methods and output interpretation guidance.

outcome_summary: Privacy risk of the AI system is examined and documented.
rationale: Privacy criteria map directly when Privacy is in the SOC 2 scope.
ai_control_to_add: Extend privacy impact assessments to training data and inferences.

outcome_summary: Fairness and bias are evaluated and results documented.
rationale: No SOC 2 equivalent.
ai_control_to_add: Add bias testing with documented thresholds.

outcome_summary: Environmental impact of model training and management is assessed.
rationale: No SOC 2 equivalent.
ai_control_to_add: Track compute and energy use for training and inference.

outcome_summary: The effectiveness of testing metrics and processes is evaluated.
rationale: Monitoring of controls applies.
ai_control_to_add: Review the AI testing approach periodically.

outcome_summary: Existing, unanticipated and emerging AI risks are tracked.
rationale: Risk assessment and change analysis apply.
ai_control_to_add: Keep an AI risk register updated with emerging risks.

outcome_summary: Risk tracking is considered where AI risks are hard to measure.
rationale: No SOC 2 equivalent.
ai_control_to_add: Use qualitative tracking for risks without metrics.

outcome_summary: End users and affected communities can report problems and appeal outcomes.
rationale: Privacy complaint handling applies.
ai_control_to_add: Create an appeal process for AI-driven outcomes.

outcome_summary: Measurement approaches are tied to deployment context and informed by domain experts.
rationale: No SOC 2 equivalent.
ai_control_to_add: Have domain experts review metrics for high-risk systems.

outcome_summary: Trustworthiness results are validated with domain experts and relevant AI actors.
rationale: No SOC 2 equivalent.
ai_control_to_add: Add a domain-expert validation step to model reviews.

outcome_summary: Performance improvements or declines are identified and documented.
rationale: Monitoring and deficiency reporting apply.
ai_control_to_add: Track performance trends in AI governance reporting.

outcome_summary: A go/no-go decision is made on whether the AI system meets its purpose and should proceed.
rationale: Change approval applies, but not a purpose-fit decision.
ai_control_to_add: Add an AI deployment gate review.

outcome_summary: Treatment of documented AI risks is prioritized.
rationale: Risk response and control selection map directly.
ai_control_to_add: Prioritize AI risks in the same risk treatment process.

outcome_summary: Responses to high-priority AI risks are planned and documented.
rationale: Risk response options, including transfer through insurance, map directly.
ai_control_to_add: Document AI risk responses in the risk register.

outcome_summary: Residual risks to downstream acquirers and end users are documented.
rationale: External communication applies.
ai_control_to_add: Disclose residual AI risks in customer-facing documentation.

outcome_summary: Resources and non-AI alternatives are considered to reduce impacts.
rationale: No requirement to consider non-AI alternatives.
ai_control_to_add: Ask about non-AI alternatives at AI intake.

outcome_summary: Mechanisms sustain the value of deployed AI systems.
rationale: Capacity and monitoring apply.
ai_control_to_add: Schedule periodic value and performance reviews.

outcome_summary: Procedures respond to and recover from newly identified risks.
rationale: Incident response and recovery map directly.
ai_control_to_add: Add AI-specific incident playbooks.

outcome_summary: Mechanisms exist to supersede, disengage or deactivate AI systems that perform outside intended use.
rationale: Incident response and rollback apply.
ai_control_to_add: Add a documented kill switch and rollback procedure.

outcome_summary: Third-party AI risks and benefits are monitored and controlled.
rationale: Vendor monitoring applies.
ai_control_to_add: Monitor vendor model changes and terms of service.

outcome_summary: Pre-trained models are monitored as part of regular maintenance.
rationale: Vulnerability and vendor monitoring apply.
ai_control_to_add: Track foundation model versions and deprecation notices.

outcome_summary: Post-deployment monitoring plans cover feedback, appeal, override, decommissioning, incidents and change.
rationale: Monitoring, incident and change controls cover parts of this.
ai_control_to_add: Write a post-deployment monitoring plan for each high-risk system.

outcome_summary: Continual improvement activities are built into AI system updates.
rationale: Deficiency remediation applies.
ai_control_to_add: Feed monitoring results into the model update cycle.

outcome_summary: Incidents and errors are communicated to relevant parties, including affected communities.
rationale: Incident and breach communication apply.
ai_control_to_add: Add AI incident communication templates.
